All device configurations will be lost. This action cannot be undone.

Do you want to continue?

confirm_device_reset_message:
This will restart the device.

The current connection will be lost and you will need to reconnect after the device restarts.

Do you want to continue?
confirm_format_device_message:
WARNING: This will format the device memory.

All stored data will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

Do you want to continue?

confirm_clear_memory_message:
This will clear all stored messages in the device memory.

All unsent data will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

Do you want to continue?

confirm_restore_defaults_message:
This will restore all application settings to default values.

Current UI values will be reset. This will not affect the device settings.

Do you want to continue?

This will overwrite all device settings with the current UI values.

Do you want to continue?
